notes.title: Update notes build 11885053
notes.notes:
The updated fixes


an issue where controls stopped working properly when playing for a long time with high FPS
the game not pausing automatically when the Steam overlay gets opened
the game not being playable on super ultra wide monitors due to overlapping UI

notes.title: Pre-Launch Update
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,
we're thrilled to release the game soon and can't wait to see Windows PC and Steam Deck players getting their hands on the game. Here's a quick tech update of what you can expect: 

21:9 (Ultrawide) support:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178786/3bf0c122cb5c6d4cd2471cd7f3eb99918666adef.jpg

FOV Slider:
We implemented a FOV slider. Please let us know if you make use of this kind of feature often and if you like it in Oceanhorn 2. :)

Steam Deck:
We played the game entirely on Steam Deck and can confirm that it works from start to finish.
